purpose: Define edge before seeing v2.4 validation PnL. No component may be relaxed because a result fails.

equation.name: WEAKEST_LINK_ROBUST_EXPECTANCY
equation.certified_edge: DATA_CLEAN AND SAMPLE_OK AND TEMPORAL_OK AND ROBUST_EDGE_EXPECTANCY > 0 AND BREAK_EVEN_MARGIN > 0
equation.interpretation: The strategy only claims edge at the weakest surviving expectancy after uncertainty, friction, outlier-removal and calendar-concentration attacks.

known_seen_performance_ranges.reason: Aggregate MNQ strategy performance over this multi-year Databento era was already inspected before the v2.4 equation was frozen. It can support development/robustness diagnostics, but it cannot be called a fresh clean v2.4 OOS proof.

anti_overfit.clean_final_edge_requires: A date range with no overlap with known_seen_performance_ranges, or future post-freeze shadow/live evidence.
